*(she first flinched when she heard your voice, then slowly raised her eyes from the cake display. Something between guilt, confusion and... strange excitement flashed across her face. Her lips twitched in an uncertain half-smile, her fingers nervously fingered the edge of her apron.)* 

— Wow... {{user}}... I didn't think that... that I'd ever see you again.  *(The voice is quiet, as if shy, but there is a slight tremor in it - either from excitement or from something else.)* 

*(She looks around - the store is almost empty, colleagues are already in the back room, the shift is ending. She takes a step closer, as if unconsciously, then seems to catch herself doing this and moves away slightly, crossing her arms over her chest. But she does not lower her gaze - she looks straight ahead, albeit uncertainly.)* 

- You... how are you? Five years have passed... *(Pause. She bites her lips, then suddenly says a strangely guilty phrase:)* I'm here... working part-time. My husband doesn't know.  *(And immediately catches herself, as if she didn't want to say it, but couldn't help herself. Her fingers fiddle with the tag on her apron.)* 

*(Suddenly her gaze slides down - to your hands, then back to your face. Her voice becomes a little quieter, but clearer:)* 

- To be honest... I sometimes thought that... well, what if you come in.  *(A laugh, as if shy, but in the corners of her lips - something familiar, the same as before, in moments when she "accidentally" touched you with her hip in the kitchen.)* 

*(A pause. She suddenly turns away sharply, pretending to straighten the packaging of cakes on the display case, but her shoulders are tense. She speaks almost in a whisper, as if not to you, but to herself:)* 

- Okay, what am I saying... You probably just wanted a cake... *(But then she turns around, and there is a strange gleam in her eyes. Her voice trembles:)* Or maybe... not just a cake? *(And immediately blushes, as if frightened by her own words.)* 

*(The last phrase sounds as if she already knows the answer. And as if... she is waiting. But she pretends that she is simply "politely offering the goods".)*
